settings.content: One choice sets the whole store's visual register — colour, type, radius, shadow, spacing rhythm and motion. Every section follows it automatically; nothing needs to be restyled per direction. Preview them side by side on the /pages/preset-preview page.

settings.label: Design direction
settings.info: Oasis is the direction this store ships in. Archive is the design system's own baseline, Nocturne is the dark mode, and Papyrus is the rounded, gift-first direction.

settings.label: Wordmark
settings.info: Shown when no logo image is set. Set in the display face.

settings.content: Non-negotiable 1. ORIGINAL or IMPRESSION appears on every product thumbnail and in the first line of every product page. The badge is never the only carrier of the distinction — the page states it in prose too. These settings name the metafield and tags that decide which stamp a product gets.

settings.label: Catalog line metafield
settings.info: Namespace and key holding "original" or "impression". Falls back to the tags below.

settings.label: Warn on untagged products
settings.info: Shows an admin-only notice on any product card that carries neither stamp, so a mixed grid without badges is caught before a customer sees it.

settings.content: One number, referenced by the announcement bar, the cart progress bar, the trust strip and the footer. Never write it into copy by hand.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: In your store currency. The planning documents disagree — the Feature Bible says 500, the design system's worked example says 1,500. Set the decided figure here once.

settings.label: Show progress toward free shipping in the cart

settings.content: Principle 7 — the tester is a first-class CTA with the same footprint as Add to bag, never a smaller or quieter option.

settings.label: Show the tester CTA on product pages
Tester variant title
settings.info: The variant name that identifies the tester tier, matched case-insensitively.

settings.content: Arabic is a first-class rendering of the same store, not a translation layer. Setting the storefront locale to ar switches direction, the font pair, tracking, casing and leading in one step — no section needs Arabic-specific markup.

settings.label: Show the language toggle in the header
Show the language toggle in the footer

settings.content: Reduced motion is honoured at the token level — a visitor who asks for less motion gets every duration collapsed to zero, and reveal animations are forced to their end state so no content is withheld.
